title: Check your understanding
instruction: Think of your answer before revealing it. Select the card again to return to the prompt.

front.heading: Traceability
front.text: What should someone else be able to retrace?
front.label: Think first

back.text: The connection between a decision, its source requirements and its supporting evidence.

front.heading: Assumption
front.text: What needs to be made explicit?

back.label: Check your answer
back.text: A condition accepted as true for the review. Record its effect and whether confirmation is needed before the decision is finalized.
The available evidence against a stated requirement, recording what was confirmed and any gaps that remain.
